hero.title: What goes out, coded correctly when it comes back.
hero.lead: Zoho Invoice or Jobber, connected to your bookkeeping so an invoice doesn't need to be re-entered by hand once it's paid.
hero.note: Ask us if [funding](/funding) might be available.

paragraphs: Invoicing software is what generates and tracks what you bill clients — Zoho Invoice for a general services business, Jobber where invoicing follows a job. The point of configuring it properly is that it feeds your bookkeeping directly: a paid invoice lands coded correctly instead of as a lump your bookkeeper has to unpick by hand.

sections.title: Set up once, feeds the books automatically.
items: Platform selection and setup, tied to how billing actually happens in your business.
Integration with your bookkeeping software, so nothing gets retyped.
Templates, payment terms, and automated reminders configured once, not per-invoice.
sections.note: See [bookkeeping and payroll software](/managed-it-services/bookkeeping-payroll-software) for the half this feeds into.

items.a: No — this is the software that feeds your books. Whoever does your bookkeeping (you or your accountant) still works from what it produces.

items.q: Can clients pay directly through the invoice?
items.a: Yes, where the platform supports it — online payment links are part of the setup.
